fact: ANIP data released 26 January 2026 say identification procedures were handled online in 2025, 37% through eservices.anip.bj, 30% through the ANIP BJ mobile app and 8% by USSD.
source_slug: 2026-01-28 Benin Advances E-Government With Mass Digital ID Adoption

fact: The ANIP playbook lists eservices.anip.bj and the ANIP BJ mobile app as access channels to online services, alongside USSD *151# and in-person.
Fraternite reports over 1,000 services digitised in Benin since 2016, more than 210 of them fully paperless, through the official portal service-public.bj.
Fraternite reports citizens can retrieve birth, marriage and nationality certificates online through eservices.anip.bj and the ANIP BJ mobile app.
The ANDF director general announced in October 2024 that nine land e-services were accessible on the national public services platform service-public.bj.
